Team —

We ran the run-rate simulation this morning and there are several mid-market deals (primarily the Acme cluster) where we’re under-covered against the Q2 ARR plan once we factor in conversion velocity and expected close cadence. Finance is asking for a clean reconciliation of committed ACV vs. expected recognition so they can finalize the monthly cash flow model.

Asks:
- Owners: please update the "commit" column in the attached Q2_pipeline_runrate.xlsx by EOD Wednesday 24-Mar (green/yellow/red + brief note).
- Marcus: can you roster backup owners for the 4 deals in stage "Negotiation"? We need fallback contacts if the primary owner goes dark.
- Aditya: flag any commercial gating (discount approvals / PO timing) — I’ll pull those into the finance note.
- Naomi: once owners update, can your team reconcile with the finance_recon_template.csv (attached) and call out delta to recognized revenue timeline by Thursday 25-Mar?

I’m consolidating a single view for the execs and finance; I want to avoid over-optimistic inflations in the model. If you anticipate a soft commit (less than 60% probability), mark it as "Likely Pull" with the trigger that would move it back to green.

Attachments: Q2_pipeline_runrate.xlsx (sheet: roster), finance_recon_template.csv

Thanks — I’ll run a roll-up Friday morning and schedule a 15-min readout if there’s material movement.

—
